torrent.title: Torrents
torrent.invalid_magnet: This is not a magnet link
torrent.no_file_picker: This device has no file picker. Open the .torrent file from a file manager using “Open with”.
torrent.empty: No torrents yet. Add a magnet link or a .torrent file — playback starts while the file is still downloading.
torrent.legal: Only download content you have the right to watch.
torrent.metadata_slow: This is taking a while — the torrent may have few peers.
torrent.no_video: No video or audio files in this torrent
torrent.keep_files_hint: Otherwise downloaded data is deleted a day after watching
torrent.network_any_hint: Download and seed on any network, including mobile data
torrent.network_seed_wifi_hint: Watch anywhere; on mobile data background torrents wait for Wi-Fi and upload is capped at 16 KB/s
torrent.network_wifi_only_hint: Torrents do not run on mobile data; the player asks before opening one
torrent.seed_policy_hint: When a downloaded torrent that is not being watched stops seeding
torrent.seed_charging_hint: Background torrents wait for the charger to save battery. Watching always works
torrent.mobile_limit_hint: Speed limit on metered networks so you don't burn through your data plan
torrent.mobile_text: Torrents are set to Wi-Fi only. Watch over mobile data? It may cost money. The permission lasts until you connect to Wi-Fi.
